note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 1 June 1967 in Carrickfergus Rural and Glynn. All 16 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (R. Beck, returning officer; Larne Times, 8 June 1967, p. 9): two polls, twelve sole candidates declared elected, and in Ballycorr and Middle Division the retired members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of residence are not reproduced. Returned unopposed.
